data.location: 12230 W. Lake Houston Pkwy, Suite 165, Houston, TX 77044
data.status: set to open by this fall
data.short_description: A new Wingstop franchise location is planned for the W. Lake Village development in Houston. A permit has been filed for a $250,000 construction project slated to start mid-July and wrap up by mid-September. The franchisee is the GSR Group, run by Rahul Agrawal.

Bourbon Street Grill, a Cajun-inspired fast-casual concept, officially opened in the Natick Mall food court, replacing Cajun Cafe. The restaurant is operated by Tuo "Todd" Xiao and Xing, and took approximately six months of pre-opening preparation including renovation and fire safety work. The menu features Cajun and Creole flavors prepared using grilling, wok cooking, and frying techniques.

The Capitol Hill cocktail bar Laurel is set to close on June 6 as owner Kate Opatz prepares to reshape the space for a new concept. Details about the new concept and its opening timeline have not yet been publicly shared. Laurel opened in spring 2025 as a coffee and cocktail destination in the former Crumble & Flake bakery space.

data.status: opening timeline has not yet been announced
data.short_description: GoodMart, a new market and dining counter concept from Local Tide chef Victor Steinbrueck, is planned for the former Kathy Casey Food Studios space in Old Ballard. Construction is reportedly underway with Dovetail as general contractor and Heliotrope Architects leading design. No opening timeline has been announced.

Kaiya is a new 12-seat Japanese omakase concept set to debut inside the Lido House boutique hotel in Newport Beach. The project involves executive chef partner Riley Huddleston and chef Brian Kim, with Huddleston described as the visionary behind the concept. Menu details have not yet been announced.

Jack's Family Restaurant has filed a subdivision application with the Memphis and Shelby County Division of Planning and Development for a new location at 6480 Winchester Road. The application status is listed as "pending" as of May 28, and approval is still required before construction can begin. No definitive opening timeline has been provided.

data.location: 7100 Fairway Dr, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33418
data.status: No official opening date has been announced
data.short_description: PBC Cafe Stuart has filed permit applications with the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation to open a Pilar Coffee Bar at 7100 Fairway Drive. No official opening date has been announced. Pilar Coffee Bar specializes in coffees made with mountain-grown beans from Brazil and Colombia, along with pastries and an all-day menu.

data.location: College Street, Toronto (exact address not specified in article)
data.status: scheduled to open in early June
data.short_description: Mabel's Bakery is preparing to open a new location on College Street in Toronto, moving into the longtime home of Riviera Bakery, which operated in the neighborhood for roughly 50 years. A letter from founder Lorraine Hawley confirms the transition and notes renovation plans ahead of the opening. Customers can expect a mix of Mabel's Bakery items along with select classic Riviera Bakery products.

data.location: 830 S. Military Trail, Suite A, Deerfield Beach, FL 33442
data.short_description: Big Boy Eats LLC has filed permit applications to open a Smoothie King at 830 S. Military Trail, Suite A, in West Palm Beach. The Smoothie King website confirms the location will be "blending soon," though no exact opening date has been announced. Smoothie King offers fruit smoothies, bowls, and a line of "power eats" including avocado toast and protein boxes.

data.status: certificate of occupancy issued; opening timeline not yet available
data.short_description: Hungry AF Eats & Catering has been issued a certificate of occupancy by the Memphis and Shelby County Division of Planning and Development for a new restaurant at 3364 Poplar Avenue. The 2,300-square-foot space will have an occupant load of 45 and offer both dine-in and takeout service. No opening timeline has been announced.

La Rotonde, a new coffee, music, and wine-focused concept from Valle Hospitality Group LLC, is preparing to open in Hillcrest at 3968 Fifth Ave in the former Makai Sushi space. An exact opening date has not been announced, though the company's website states a summer 2026 opening. No menu details or interior plans have been shared publicly at this time.

data.store_name: AGO Coffee Bar (Art Gallery of Ontario)
data.location: 317 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M5T 1G4, Canada
data.short_description: The Art Gallery of Ontario is adding a new coffee bar and redesigned community-focused retail space to its Toronto location, backed by funding from the RBC Foundation Community Spaces Grant program. Construction is expected to begin in June 2026, led by B+H Architects and CHIL Interior Design. The redesigned space will remain accessible without museum admission and is intended to improve the visitor experience while creating community gathering opportunities.
